text: trap 'echo "Error on line $LINENO. Command exited with status $?"' ERR

while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    echo "Processing: $file"
done < <(find . -type f -name '*.txt' -print0)
source: Bash 1k: Safe Null-Delimited File Loop with Process Substitution

text: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "jq is required but not installed." >&2; exit 1; }

mapfile -t lines < <(git status --porcelain)
for line in "${lines[@]}"; do
    echo "Modified: $line"
done
